headline: Shivamogga reports 29% child stunting, below state average; district pioneers child protection and nutrition programs
summary: Shivamogga district shows 29% child stunting among under-five children, performing better than India's 32% rate. The district has 2,460 Anganwadi centers providing supplementary nutrition and pre-school education to children aged 0-6 years. Women's anaemia stands at 41.8%, also below national levels. The district pioneered Mission Suraksha to prevent child marriages, stopping 54 cases since July 2023. Shivamogga operates seven ICDS projects focusing on health, nutrition awareness, and child development through comprehensive departmental infrastructure.
